description: Late Iron Age - Roman quarry and settlement, just north east Blaise hillfort where a temple was present. It is suggested by the RSRB that due to the coins from the area, and I might add the neonatal remains interred into the former quarry, that there is a possibility they were used as a 'shrine'. Site appears to have been abandoned by the late 4th CE, and the evidence used to suggest a 'shrine' only appears after the initial quarry pits are backfilled in the late 1st CE.
